organization.name: Kailash Nadh and listmonk contributors; developed at Zerodha
organization.notes: Official homepage says Since2018. Public repository maintained under knadh; Zerodha officially lists listmonk among projects built and dog-fooded there. No standalone venture-financed company identified; this funding status concerns the project, not Zerodha.

pricingTiers.name: listmonk
pricingTiers.notes: Free AGPL application; database, server and email-transport costs separate.
No explicitly highlighted Most popular or Recommended plan found in the public pricing page.
No commercial Team/Business software edition; linked hosting providers unaffiliated.
No Enterprise software tier published; external hosting providers not first-party enterprise plans.

moats.claim: Single-binary design and production-proven bulk delivery are useful engineering differentiation, while AGPL and standard SMTP limit exclusive lock-in.

productReasons.claim: SQL expressions segment large subscriber lists using custom subscriber data.
Multi-SMTP queues expose throughput and sliding-window rate controls for bulk campaigns.
Go templates and messenger webhooks extend campaigns into dynamic email and other message channels.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate sponsorship established in the checked project/business pages; commercial steward included as business fallback.

requirements.condition: Always; application includes UI and delivery workers.
For email campaign delivery; configurable one or multiple servers.
Alternative media storage configured in app.

resources.os: Published binaries for Linux,macOS,Windows and BSD
resources.notes: 57MB observed in a7million-email production campaign is a benchmark, not a minimum. No guaranteed hardware minimum.

selfHosting.notes: Stable binary/container install with Postgres; no Node/Go build tool needed for prebuilt binary and no separate Redis/worker service documented. Homepage now advertises7beta; use stable release for production.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official installation docs describe binary and manual Docker Compose. Homepage references unaffiliated third-party hosting but current extract gives no verifiable provider shortcut URL; none recorded.
